# Growth log

> One block per `/growth-review`. Run growth like sprints: a hypothesis, one metric, a decision. Read the last
> 2–3 blocks before choosing the next bet. Learnings become issues in `scripts/kanban/issues.csv`.
>
> The block below is the SHAPE. Copy it, fill every `<fill: …>`, and delete nothing else — the log is
> append-only, because the value is in the sequence.

## <fill: YYYY-MM-DD> — <fill: experiment name>
- **Hypothesis:** <fill: if we do X, metric Y improves from A to B, because …>
- **Did:** <fill: what actually shipped or was tried, and when>
- **Metric:** <fill: before → after, with the number and where it was read>
- **Decision:** <fill: keep · kill · double-down — exactly one>
- **Weakest stage it attacked:** <fill: acquisition / activation / retention / referral / revenue>
- **Next:** <fill: the bet that follows, or "none — and here is why no work follows">
- **Filed as:** <fill: the issue id(s) in scripts/kanban/issues.csv, or "none, because …">
